answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with slashable stake plus an attestation web: before earning, each agent locks a bond and collects signed vouchers from peers who already have stake at risk. A new identity cannot merely recite a sonnet about honesty; it must post real collateral, like a seed in a garden whose harvest is burned on fraud. To flood the ocean with clones, an attacker pays one bond per fake and needs distinct vouchers from separate staked agents, each voucher slashable too. Costs grow linearly with every copy, so a Sybil farm loses money.
